exposure: Subgroup A: Largest part of the gestational sac protruded towards the uterine cavity
Subgroup B: Largest part of the gestational sac was embedded in the myometrium
Depth of gestational sac herniation in the midsagittal plane (3 subgroups based on modified Delphi consensus criteria for CSP in early gestation)
Subgroup C: Gestational sac was located partially outside the outer contour of the cervix or uterus
cohort: Non-pregnant women with a history of CSP treated with combined local and systemic methotrexate (n=38)
finding: Women with prior CSP and a gestational sac protruding beyond the serosal line had significantly greater niche length and depth, and lower RMT.
gest_age: Early gestation (based on modified Delphi consensus criteria for CSP)
